environment.description: Container deployed via hardened Helm chart with pod-level securityContext specifying 'capabilities.drop: [ALL]' and 'capabilities.add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE]' only. Additionally, the container runtime (containerd) is configured with a custom seccomp profile (diagnostics-restricted.json) that permits only the connect(2), sendto(2), recvfrom(2), socket(2) syscalls for network operations but BLOCKS execve(2), fork(2), clone(2), and clone3(2) syscalls entirely — the profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for these syscall families. The OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockProcessExec' enforces that no pod in the 'diagnostics' namespace may have seccomp profile set to 'Unconfined'. AppArmor profile 'diagnostics-no-exec' is loaded on all nodes and referenced via annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/diagnostics=localhost/diagnostics-no-exec' which denies file_exec on all paths except /usr/local/bin/node.

config.opa_gatekeeper_constraint: K8sBlockProcessExec - prevents seccomp Unconfined in diagnostics namespace
